stops.name: Parque natural de la Corona Forestal
stops.detail: The Natural Park of the Forest Corona, on the island of Tenerife (Canary Islands, Spain), is an environmental protected area. A total of 46 612.9 hectares is the largest protected natural space of the Canary Islands, stretching from about 300 metres above sea level to 2718 metres at Alto de Guajara. The protected area lies at the back of Pedro Gil, Abeque and Adeje.)
